status_note: Planning baseline. All requirements are planned; no tests, implementations, or evidence are claimed. Technical defaults remain proposals until their milestone decisions.

requirements.title: Browser-only single-room application
requirements.acceptance: Create/edit/save one room without an account or application backend; production artifact works on static HTTPS hosting.
requirements.planned_evidence: Browser end-to-end; deployment network inspection

requirements.title: Desktop and tablet editing
requirements.acceptance: Complete required modeling operations on desktop mouse/keyboard and real iPad/Android tablet touch.
requirements.planned_evidence: Operation parity matrix; physical-device protocol

requirements.title: Mobile shared-project viewing
requirements.acceptance: Open a received project on iOS/Android and rotate, pan, zoom, and inspect it.
requirements.planned_evidence: Fresh-profile file-open browser test; physical phones

requirements.title: Multiple room-entry mental models
requirements.acceptance: Preset editing, drawing/dimensioning, and wall-by-wall segment entry produce equivalent editable rooms.
requirements.planned_evidence: Consumer journeys; independent geometry comparisons

requirements.title: Irregular perimeter geometry
requirements.acceptance: Preserve unequal opposing walls; edit angled/curved walls and alcoves without silently rectangularizing them.
requirements.planned_evidence: Analytic line/arc fixtures; 2D/3D browser operations

requirements.title: Simplified architectural shapes
requirements.acceptance: Create columns, niches, stepped floors, sloped ceilings, and changing ceiling heights with editable dimensions.
requirements.planned_evidence: Shape fixtures; both-view editing; elevation checks

requirements.title: Wall thickness and architectural trim
requirements.acceptance: Edit wall thickness, frames, architraves, panels, baseboards, cornices, and sills; a 1 cm protrusion affects overlap.
requirements.planned_evidence: Geometry assertions; visual and collision witnesses

requirements.title: Custom ceiling beams
requirements.acceptance: Place beams with custom direction, size and elevation, including the measured fixture and intentional ceiling intersection.
requirements.planned_evidence: Analytic elevations; custom-placement browser test

requirements.title: Units and measurement provenance
requirements.acceptance: Show cm to two decimals; accept metric/imperial units; unit round trips preserve geometry and original/inferred distinction.
requirements.planned_evidence: Parser/conversion invariants; input/display browser test

requirements.title: Inconsistency and underdetermination guidance
requirements.acceptance: Distinguish insufficient angles from contradictory measurements, identify relevant geometry, preview auto-repair and undo it.
requirements.planned_evidence: Literal unresolved room; repair/cancel/undo tests

requirements.title: 2D/3D operation parity
requirements.acceptance: Create/select/edit dimensions, elevation, rotation, materials and distances in either view against the same state.
requirements.planned_evidence: Operation-by-view browser matrix

requirements.title: Attachments and usable wall edits
requirements.acceptance: Wall edits preview affected attached openings/fixtures and preserve intended positions; conflicts do not delete or silently resize objects.
requirements.planned_evidence: Command invariants; interactive conflict and anchor tests

requirements.title: Snapping and overlap feedback
requirements.acceptance: Snap to wall/floor/object/alignment targets; display snap state and textual/visual overlap warnings without prohibiting placement.
requirements.planned_evidence: Touch/mouse/keyboard cases; geometric overlap probes

requirements.title: All agreed door families
requirements.acceptance: Edit single/double hinged, wall-sliding, pocket, folding and pivot doors with applicable handing, frames, thresholds and opening amount.
requirements.planned_evidence: Per-family parameter/geometry/browser cases

requirements.title: Door movement collisions
requirements.acceptance: Detect an obstruction reached midway through door movement for every supported mechanism; distinguish touching from intersection.
requirements.planned_evidence: Independent mandatory obligations for single-hinged, double-hinged, wall-sliding, pocket, folding and pivot mechanisms; swept-motion analytic fixtures and visible warnings; paired deletion and partial-family negative gate tests

requirements.title: Window presets and custom panes
requirements.acceptance: Create fixed, hinged, tilt-and-turn and sliding pane layouts, including fixed lower section and one sliding upper half.
requirements.planned_evidence: Pane composition fixtures; preset/custom browser flows

requirements.title: Regional visual fixtures
requirements.acceptance: Place US, Israeli and enumerated European outlet variants, switches, data/TV and multi-gang plates with dimensions/elevation/protrusion.
requirements.planned_evidence: Regional inventory; measured placement/overlap cases

requirements.title: Dimensioned generic furniture and accessories
requirements.acceptance: Resize generic table/chair/cabinet width/depth/height and place furnishing accessories including shutters/blinds/screens.
requirements.planned_evidence: Category inventory; dimensions and placement cases

requirements.title: Wall/floor/furniture finishes
requirements.acceptance: Apply material/color/texture to supported surfaces, including opposite wall faces and product options; user textures survive sharing.
requirements.planned_evidence: Material browser tests; archive in fresh profile

requirements.title: Real-time realistic appearance
requirements.acceptance: Render daylight location/time, artificial lights, glass, mirrors and textures with usable tablet quality controls.
requirements.planned_evidence: Reviewed render scenes; named-device performance

requirements.title: Future multi-finish infrastructure
requirements.acceptance: Material face identifiers and a versioned region extension allow later multi-finish walls without coupling model to current renderer.
requirements.planned_evidence: Schema/ADR review; face-identity regeneration tests

requirements.title: Persistent URL-based product library
requirements.acceptance: Add product URL and available identity/dimensions/variants/materials/images/price/currency/model/provenance; reuse across projects.
requirements.planned_evidence: Fresh project library workflow; data completeness assertions

requirements.title: Variant and catalog update choices
requirements.acceptance: Preview/apply/cancel deliberate options; notify and offer keep/preview/replace for source updates without silent mutations.
requirements.planned_evidence: Version/variant removal/update/reopen tests

requirements.title: Public repository plugin installation
requirements.acceptance: Install/remove catalog plugin from public GitHub repository; validate compatibility; browser fetch published data/assets.
requirements.planned_evidence: Independent fixture plugin plus IKEA installer journey

requirements.title: Versioned plugin contract and lifecycle
requirements.acceptance: Publish schemas/examples/conformance suite; preserve old project references on uninstall; declare future importer extension boundary. Verify pinned catalog and asset content hashes, including dependent textures and cached content, before accepting resources; changed bytes at an unchanged URL/version must not silently alter a saved project.
requirements.planned_evidence: Producer/consumer contract tests; malformed/unavailable data cases; unchanged-URL/version changed-content fixtures during reopen, undo and fresh-profile sharing

requirements.title: IKEA Israel catalog
requirements.acceptance: Successfully import every frozen eligible Israeli individual product using source/inferred/generic geometry with dimensions, provenance, local options/Hebrew/available ILS prices; explained failures do not count as coverage. Removing eligible products requires an explicit user-approved scope change; nonempty holdouts must successfully import and place.
requirements.planned_evidence: Frozen eligible inventory with successful imports, separately reported exclusions/failures/fallbacks, approved retirement decisions and successful live holdout placements; negative gate case for explained failures

requirements.title: Asset fallback and honest provenance
requirements.acceptance: Use source, inferred, or dimensioned generic geometry with clear labels; never invent verified dimensions or cross-country variants.
requirements.planned_evidence: Missing-asset/dimension cases; duplication/export provenance checks

requirements.title: External catalog production
requirements.acceptance: Offline producer discovery/fetch/normalization/validation publishes complete immutable versions; failure preserves last good catalog.
requirements.planned_evidence: Recorded source tests; staged publication failure/rollback proof

requirements.title: Named layout alternatives
requirements.acceptance: Duplicate/rename independent layouts and preserve all alternatives on save/reopen without unintended cross-layout changes.
requirements.planned_evidence: Isolation and archive round-trip tests

requirements.title: Browser recovery and explicit save
requirements.acceptance: Recover local edits; explicitly save/open portable files; handle interrupted save, quota denial and concurrent tabs without silent loss.
requirements.planned_evidence: Storage fault injection; recovery and two-tab tests

requirements.title: Persistent undo and redo
requirements.acceptance: Undo/redo across geometry/product/layout edits and file reopen, preserving cursor/history dependencies through supported migrations.
requirements.planned_evidence: Transaction and serialized-history replay assertions

requirements.title: Sharing without library pollution
requirements.acceptance: Recipient opens with no plugins/library; external assets may load online; local user assets survive; adding products to library is explicit.
requirements.planned_evidence: Separate-profile recipient workflow; network failure fixture

requirements.title: Project compatibility and missing resources
requirements.acceptance: Validate/migrate versioned files; reject unsafe/malformed input helpfully; missing assets preserve editable model and visible placeholders. Content-integrity mismatches preserve saved metadata and produce a labeled placeholder/error or explicit update proposal.
requirements.planned_evidence: Old/future/corrupt/archive-limit fixtures; migration failure tests

requirements.title: Dimensioned professional drawings
requirements.acceptance: Export to-scale floor plans/elevations as PDF/SVG/DXF with units, annotations, and Hebrew labels.
requirements.planned_evidence: Independent parse/reopen; scale calibration; rendered pages

requirements.title: Schedules and shopping lists
requirements.acceptance: Export doors/windows/fixtures and product quantities/options/links/available price/date/currency as readable documents and CSV.
requirements.planned_evidence: Independent CSV/PDF assertions versus domain state

requirements.title: Material quantities
requirements.acceptance: Compute areas/quantities with explicit opening deductions and approximation indicators; report waste separately if included.
requirements.planned_evidence: Analytic area fixtures; exported quantities compared independently

requirements.title: Visual and 3D export
requirements.acceptance: Export screenshots/rendered views as PNG/JPEG and scene as GLB with correct geometry/material references.
requirements.planned_evidence: Independent image/GLB reopening and dimension checks

requirements.title: English and Hebrew
requirements.acceptance: Localize interface, messages and outputs; RTL layouts and mixed-direction text preserve numerical/model meaning.
requirements.planned_evidence: Locale coverage; visual/interaction and PDF manual review

requirements.title: Accessible interaction
requirements.acceptance: Keyboard/object-list/numerical alternatives, labels/focus/contrast, non-color-only errors, touch usability.
requirements.planned_evidence: Automated checks plus manual keyboard/screen reader/tablet protocols

requirements.title: Real-room measurement integrity
requirements.acceptance: Preserve literal measurements and uncertainties; demonstrate modeled window/sill/door/beams without inventing resolved angles or totals. The user-labeled actual opening of 70 cm retains an unresolved measurement reference and is not bound to clear passage/frame geometry without clarification.
requirements.planned_evidence: Fixture integrity; unresolved and user-accepted approximation review

requirements.title: Performance and resource resilience
requirements.acceptance: Meet frozen named-device budgets; remain responsive with loading failures and stress scenes without changing dimensions.
requirements.planned_evidence: Reproducible benchmark reports; physical-device qualification

requirements.title: Reproducible development infrastructure
requirements.acceptance: Establish AGENTS.md, pinned toolchain, useful scripts, contribution docs and reproducible static build; record dependency versions/compatibility/licenses; complete bounded M0 measurement-constraint, geometry and PDF proofs and ADRs before architecture selection. A complete integrated consumer editor is first required in M1.
requirements.planned_evidence: Clean-clone bootstrap; CI/helper-script failure probes; dependency inventory/ADRs; S01-S06 measurement-constraint, G01-G06 geometry and P01-P05 PDF results in bounded harnesses (currently not run)

requirements.title: Traceable acceptance gates
requirements.acceptance: Maintain a versioned mandatory obligation inventory independent of tests/mappings and compare against its approved baseline. Every v1 obligation requires candidate-bound evidence; paired test/mapping deletion, unapproved obligation retirement, partial-family coverage, skipped cases and stale candidate identity fail the release gate. Evidence-store identity is separate from tested-source identity.
requirements.planned_evidence: Gate negative tests including paired deletion and family coverage; evidence attachment preserves subject identity while source changes invalidate it; generated per-obligation status report

requirements.title: Qualified release and rollback
requirements.acceptance: Promote the exact tested static artifact identified by clean source commit, build digest, catalog hashes and acceptance-inventory digest; retain attestations in a separate store/branch and verify rollback/compatibility handling. Evidence attachment does not modify the tested subject.
requirements.planned_evidence: CI artifact identity; preview/deployment smoke and rollback exercise

requirements.title: Native WebMCP consumer operations
requirements.acceptance: Real browser agent inspects/edits/places through shared commands, handles ambiguity/stale proposals and preserves preview/undo.
requirements.planned_evidence: Pinned native browser/agent conversations plus contract tests

requirements.title: Multiple finish regions on one face
requirements.acceptance: Author several material regions on one wall face using preserved extension infrastructure.
requirements.planned_evidence: Future feature acceptance; not a v1 gate

requirements.title: Additional IKEA country catalogs
requirements.acceptance: Add further countries without substituting identities/options/prices across markets.
requirements.planned_evidence: Future country-specific plugin fixtures

requirements.title: Standalone-file importer plugins
requirements.acceptance: Community importer extension can safely produce compatible objects from user-selected files; first-party importer not required for v1.
requirements.planned_evidence: Future extension/sandbox contract acceptance

requirements.title: Configurable multi-product systems
requirements.acceptance: Represent configurable wardrobe/shelving combinations beyond individual articles.
requirements.planned_evidence: Future configuration acceptance

requirements.title: Drawer and walking clearances
requirements.acceptance: Add drawer/cabinet movement and walking clearance checks beyond v1 door motion.
requirements.planned_evidence: Future motion/clearance acceptance
